items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Sarah Vaughn and Jimmy Jones, but Interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond or confirm any personal connection.

ctx.x: Ran their ass out of there. And so they had a--they booked Sarah Vaughn at the Harlem Square. She had Jimmy Jones--Jimmy Jones was playing piano for her. He was her accompanist.
